sentences.text:
"It is therefore most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to direct the court's below to decide the Special Criminal Pocso Act No.08/2016 (State -vs-Fanidramani Ojha and another) arising out of case crime no.
875 of 2015, under section 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Kotwali Bansi, District Siddharthnagar, pending in the court of Session Judge Siddharthnagar, within short span of time without granting any adjournment between both the parties, otherwise the applicant shall suffer an irreparable loss and injury.
And/or to pass any such other or further order as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the present facts and circumstances of the case."
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is the first informant of the matter.

entities.text: Special Criminal Pocso Act No.08/2016 (State -vs-Fanidramani Ojha and another)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that the F.I.R. was lodged on 28.7.2015 and a charge sheet was submitted on 08.2.2016 and then the trial court concerned took cognizance upon the same on 16.8.2016.

It is submitted that charges against the opposite party nos. 2/Fanidra Mani Ojha@Dablu Ojha and 3/Ajay Kumar Giri@Rinku Giri were framed on 15.12.2016 and since then the trial in the matter is going on and the trial is being adjourned and the accused are not co-operating in the trial.
It is submitted that a direction be issued to the concerned trial court for expeditious disposal of the matter.

5. A perusal of the order sheet of the trial court which is from 16.3.2016 to 23.2.2023 goes to show that the trial is pending in the matter and only the statement of P.W.-1 has been recorded till date.

6. In view of the same, it is provided that the applicant may file an application before the concerned trial court for expediting the trial upon which the trial court shall consider and decide the same looking to the pendency of the trial and pass appropriate orders subject to any legal impediment.
7. The present application is disposed of.

(Samit Gopal,J.) Order Date :- 15.4.2024 Naresh  Ram Kishore Yadav vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12286886/
